name: MES SMA(50,200) + 2.0xATR trend strategy (live paper strategy)

source.repo_or_note: root CLAUDE.md + engine/CLAUDE.md Active Instruments table; PR #552/#598/#691 gate history
source.imported_via: pre-existing in engine; seeded into registry 2026-09-12

hypothesis: MES mean-reverts within trend: when the 50-SMA is above the 200-SMA (uptrend) and price extends >= 2.0x ATR below the 50-SMA, a long mean-reversion entry captures the snap-back with a stop below the extension.

rules.entry: Long only: 50-SMA above 200-SMA AND price <= 50-SMA - 2.0*ATR (per engine/CLAUDE.md Active Instruments).
rules.exit: Stop/target per engine trade_invariants long/short direction checks; full logic in engine code.
rules.position_sizing: Per engine position sizing; $5K/instrument cap (root CLAUDE.md).
rules.risk_limits: Kill switch -8% daily P&L / -20% drawdown (MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT=0.20 in engine/.env); DO_NOT_TRADE_SYMBOLS gate; paper-only (IB 4002).
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Per engine backtest model; see engine/backtest for the fill assumption.

reasons: as_of 2026-07-29 (PRB-02 banner in docs/CURRENT_STATE.md): overall_pass=false for MES; profit_factor 1.79 < 2.0 target; win_rate 43.75% < 55%; 16/60 trades; 15/30 days
MES is the only live paper strategy, but the authorizing gate verdict (MES_stark_gapfill_long_rank1.json) belongs to a different strategy — PRB-02 fix makes eligibility strategy-specific

known_failure_modes: Paper profit factor and win rate below targets as of 2026-07-29 snapshot
Symbol-wide gate authorization bug (PRB-02) previously let an unrelated strategy's PASS authorize MES routing
Registry entry is a snapshot — refresh gate_verdict against the live endpoint before any state change
